description: This file contains CMake functions and script snippets for configuring and installing header-only libraries and packages, including generating config files and package configuration files for consumption by other projects.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a CMake configuration package for a given target, handling dependencies, versioning, and target aliasing.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates a package configuration file (e.g., .pc) for header-only libraries, including options for customizing include directories, compile options, and dependencies.
